english.title: Procure a poison / noxious thing to cause a miscarriage
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) unlawfully procured a poison or other noxious thing, namely **(..SPECIFY THE THING..), knowing that the same was intended to be unlawfully used or employed with intent to procure the miscarriage of a woman named **(..SPECIFY THE NAME..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 59 of the Offences Against the Person Act 1861.

english.notes:
(i) A woman having an abortion does not commit an offence when acting in relation to her own pregnancy, see section 241 of the Crime and Policing Act 2026.
(ii) The woman in this case does not have to be with child (pregnant).
